verdict_text:
YES

The script drops blocks 2, 5, 8, maps the survivors 0,1,3,4,6,7,9,10,11 onto 0..8 in original order, and passes every tensor through unchanged in value, shape and dtype. Building a fresh output dict avoids the rename collision hazard. The two asserts run before any write and cover all three required checks: the layer-index set must equal exactly {0..8}, which rules out blocks 9, 10, 11 and forces exactly 9 blocks, and the tensor count must be 121. The only thing not visible from the artifact is the `_ckpt.load_checkpoint` helper, which I assume returns a plain name-to-tensor dict of the input file.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
